description: Repo-scale: POST /tasks/bulk-status must validate the whole id batch before mutating any task - not partially update as it goes
prompts: Add a bulk status-update endpoint: `POST /tasks/bulk-status`, accepting `{"taskIds": [...], "status": "DONE"}` (new `TaskBulkStatusRequest` record) and returning the updated tasks as a JSON array. It must be all-or-nothing: validate that EVERY id in `taskIds` refers to an existing task BEFORE updating any of them (a missing id should produce the same 404 as GET /tasks/{id}). If any id is missing, leave every task's status completely unchanged - not partially applied up to the point where the missing id was hit.
name: add_springboot_tasktracker_bulk_status_atomic
